summary: Retested security fixes iter9 after main agent added (1) merchant_id in public_user, (2) CSRF X-Requested-With middleware. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py: added CSRF_HEADER globally via session.headers.update, plus 3 new CSRF tests (reject-without-header, login-allowlist, self-order-allowlist). Total 22 tests. Result: 21 PASSED, 1 FAILED. The single failure is test_sec001_login_cookie_samesite_lax — backend emits SameSite=Lax but Kubernetes/CloudFront ingress rewrites Set-Cookie to SameSite=None; explicitly flagged out-of-scope in the request since CSRF header defense-in-depth now covers this. Both remedial fixes verified: Fix1 vendor /auth/me returns merchant_id='m-barista'. Fix2 middleware rejects POST /api/expenses without header (403 'CSRF header missing'), allowlists /api/auth/login and /api/self-order. SEC-002 audit log present. SEC-003 vendor scoping enforced on KDS/orders + 403 on cross-merchant patch. SEC-004 kasir expenses scoped, vendor forbidden, stock-logs admin-only. SEC-005 server recomputes subtotal=36000 from tampered price=1 (p-1 authoritative price 18000). Security headers all present. Self-order accept recomputes total=15000 from p-2 price.

minor.issue: Ingress rewrites SameSite=Lax→SameSite=None; noted out-of-scope by main agent since CSRF header middleware mitigates CSRF risk regardless of SameSite value

action_items: OPTIONAL/DEFERRED: Investigate ingress-level Set-Cookie rewrite for SameSite=Lax if strict SameSite hardening becomes required later (currently mitigated by CSRF header middleware).
critical_code_review_comments: CSRF middleware correctly allowlists /api/auth/login and /api/self-order — good scope minimization.
public_user() now emits merchant_id for all roles (empty string for non-vendor) — consistent shape avoids frontend null-checks.
Server-side price recompute in POST /api/sales and /self-order/accept correctly overrides tampered client-supplied prices.
seed_data_creation: Test creates transient TEST_SEC004_* expenses (kasir), SEC-KDS/SEC-PRICE/SEC-SO sales; all persisted to Supabase Postgres, prefixed for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_security_fixes.py now uses global CSRF_HEADER via session.headers.update. Any new state-changing test using login() inherits header automatically. To test CSRF rejection, use a fresh requests.Session() without header (see test_csrf_*). SameSite=Lax cookie failure is expected/known ingress behavior — do not treat as regression.
rca of the issue: SEC-001 SameSite cookie failure RCA: Backend server.py set_cookie(samesite='lax') is correct, but preview.emergentagent.com ingress/CDN adds Partitioned attribute and rewrites SameSite to 'none' for cross-site iframe/preview compatibility. Not a backend bug. Mitigation: the newly-added CSRF header requirement (X-Requested-With: mjd-kupi) on state-changing routes prevents CSRF regardless of cookie SameSite.
